title: Let's put a cutie under your 🎄 (Dating ⧸ Relationships Q&A)
summary: A three-hour dating and relationships Q&A stream, his first since leaving his machine learning job to work on the channel full time. He covers approaching women, commitment, cheating, when to move in together and have kids, plus side topics: finger curls, ageing without TRT, which muscles women find attractive, program hopping, philosophy, anime and why he left France.
claims: After an arm-wrestling session the strain on his elbow was severe, which made him understand why arm wrestlers constantly rehab
He now does finger curls more than ever, on a cable stack: open the fingers so the handle rolls to the fingertips, then close; reps of 15
If dumbbell finger curls hurt your wrist, switch to the cable variation
He left his employer and now makes his own schedule; he is busier than ever but likes the change
Money matters enormously because living costs have exploded: rent went from about 300 to about 2000 a month since his childhood, and what he earns now would have seemed rich to him as a kid
Passion does not matter in work; a job is for making a living, and turning your passion into income can destroy the passion
Seeing a begging girl in India shooed away, then giving her food scraps that meant a week of food to her, taught him how blessed Westerners are and why gratitude matters
He is not a fan of the Sendback squat
Semen retention is a meme and potentially dangerous; it only helps as a way of stopping a porn or masturbation addiction
He socializes outside his marriage only once every four or five months and is fine with it, though he knows many people need more
Learning by immersion is the best way; he got his English to a high level because in America he had to speak English or fail
Men often become submissive right after entering a relationship out of fear of losing it, and that submissiveness is often what costs them the relationship
Not acting needy starts with knowing you have value; women like men with options
An average-looking man can land a pretty woman if he is funny, charismatic, confident and treats women well; you do not need to be a Chad
The idea that metabolism and testosterone crash at 30 or 40 is false; it is a consequence of people giving up, and you can stay lean and strong into your 60s without TRT
Lean college guys often get a gut by their late 20s because their training came from college sports, not their own discipline
Look your best as a man in your 30s and 40s; at 22 you are at the very start, so improve your appearance as much as possible
Every viewer who asked whether to approach a girl and went for it reported that it worked: a 100% success rate, so most men overthink this
Never being satisfied with a partner is like endlessly clicking for the perfect porn video; likewise the best training program is the one you stick with, so program hopping is as bad as woman hopping
Getting attention from women does not build self-worth; if you do not love yourself you will resent anyone who likes you, so build self-worth on your own first
Saying you have a zero-lies boundary is too rigid; small protective lies exist in every relationship, and only a serious lie should end one
Emotional maturity, understanding how your actions affect others, is a trait women look for, and men without it make poor partners
Leagues are real; couples of similar attractiveness are more stable, while a big gap creates insecurity unless career, charisma or money offset it, and those can disappear
If your partner spirals and drags you down while you self-improve, she may not be the one; some women even feed dieting partners treats to keep them fat
The right time to ask a girl out is always yesterday; by the time a man notices her interest she may already be moving on
When a relationship makes you miserable, picture yourself 20 years later with that person; fear of being alone is not a reason to stay
A couple that drifts apart when life gets hard lacks the core of a relationship, which is leaning on each other in hard times
His favorite first date is a walk: conversation flows, there is an activity, chances for playful touch, then a restaurant or movie if it goes well; walk where there are people
Truly lasting accomplishments take a long time; very hard things cannot be done in a short time
He avoids video games because his addictive personality makes him obsessed
He would rather be short and jacked than tall and skinny
Facial beauty matters more than physique because you cannot grow facial beauty but you can grow your physique
About 30 is the ideal age to have kids: established career and income, still energetic, and you can be an active grandparent at 60
Bodybuilding correlates with getting girls; as his physique improved, women started approaching him, even at the beach with his wife
Unless there is a medical reason, a partner gaining a lot of weight is a sign of letting yourself go; he has lost people who did not take care of themselves
Being nice is not a virtue; it is passive, and women reject nice guys who have nothing else to offer
He has never paid on a first date, only once a relationship became serious
Cheating, including emotional cheating, is a conscious choice and kills the relationship; a woman constantly talking about one male friend is a warning sign
Women find the glutes the most attractive male muscle, then abs, then arms; they barely care about back, traps or lats
He prefers soft, not shredded, women and has no interest in muscular fitness physiques; most women are naturally beautiful without the gym while men must train
His wife is his main motivation; without her he would live as a bum in a cabin, and before her he owned a mattress on stacks of books and one chair

Women who want to stay strong but soft should not diet, eat at maintenance or slightly above, do lots of lower-body work like squats and posterior-chain lifts, and they will not get hard naturally because most lack the genetics
Most women look better slightly heavier
Small legs and a small butt are the least attractive traits; the thigh-gap era looked like underfeeding
Alex 405 is a freak on the bench; with his build he would like to see him specialize in a lower-body lift
Street lifting is incomplete for bodybuilding but excellent for the upper body
Men compliment each other's muscles partly as a give-and-take, since praising someone's biceps invites praise back
Defining a pencil neck: an average neck sits roughly in line with the jaw when relaxed, much smaller is a pencil neck; a slim neck is attractive on women
Never marry someone you have not lived with; date about 1.5-2 years, live together 1-2 years, then marry
When you think you should reach out to a friend, do it now, the same as when you think you should train: never say tomorrow
Isolating when you feel bad is a mistake; that is when friends can support you most
Changing exercises out of boredom is like chasing novelty in life; most people follow shock-the-muscle advice for boredom, not results
Finding a woman with a woman's own friends, hobbies, income, work ethic and kindness are top green flags; two hard workers make life far easier
A woman asking a random guy to spot her squat is a clear sign of sexual interest
Leave women alone at the gym; a woman wanting to approach a man can simply ask him to carry a plate
He has never been drunk; five or six shots in Paris did not make him tipsy
He has never trained on weed and does not like it
His wife cares about fitness only through him; a 450 lb squat PR for 3 means nothing to her
He refuses to monetize the channel with ads or sponsors and plans to live off Ko-fi memberships and a coaching or teaching service launching end of December 2024
Physique reviews are normally delivered within about three days of request
Most of the hedonistic Q&A advice: personality matters more than money for dating, and confidence, competence, strength and charisma are what women look for
You must keep dating your wife: restaurants, flowers, attention, because women fear abandonment
Living with a partner, never be a hindrance: do your laundry, cook and clean
